Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Seoul Hero future staff individual PNG artwork.
ANATOMY PRIORITY: exactly tiny squat SD body, the head including hair is 60 percent of the total subject height. The body from chin to shoe soles occupies only 40 percent. Very small mittens for the empty hands close against the short torso. Feet sit directly below the tiny torso. No visible long thigh, no long shin, no realistic knee anatomy. Tiny squat boots and scarcely visible legs. Cartoon SD face, no realistic adult anatomy. Preserve this proportion before costume detail.
FINAL BODY DESIGN: a round squat SD doll, not a miniature adult. No defined breasts, no hourglass waist, no slim adult hips, no visible long thigh segments, no realistic knees or shin segments. Torso is one very short compact costume block. Tiny mitten hands and small boots connect immediately around that block; legs are scarcely visible. Costume sleeves, belts and shorts must adapt to this doll anatomy.
Primary request: A full-body super-deformed Seoul guild staff member: a woman with asymmetrical chin-length hair, rectangular glasses and a compact lightweight zip shell. Occupational clothing: cropped power-room uniforms with broad ceramic-looking safety pads and sealed tiny utility pockets. Huge readable head about 60 percent of total height, a tiny compact torso, extremely short arms and legs, large expressive eyes and clearly visible empty small hands. Relaxed friendly three-quarter front neutral pose, tiny feet close together. Distinct hair, headwear and jacket contour, one clean hand-painted PNG, transparent background. No held paperwork, tools, weapons, official logos, text, UI frame, realistic limbs or individual attack rig.
Style: original crisp Korean mobile-game hand-painted raster art, strong readable silhouettes, clean navy outlines where appropriate, restrained cel shading and material highlights. Follow the specific subject palette in the brief. Create a new silhouette and object, with no copied reference subject.
One full-body Korean guild employee. Match reference SD proportion: head about 60 percent of height, tiny torso, extremely short limbs. BOTH HANDS EMPTY, relaxed idle stance. No handheld tool, no floor shadow, no rig parts.
Composition: single subject fully inside canvas, centered with 8 percent safe padding. No contact sheet or multiple examples.
Background: actual transparent RGBA, no opaque backdrop, no fake checkerboard.
Constraints: no text, logos, watermark, UI chrome, labels or numbers. Preserve the requested anatomy and view.


FINAL REQUIRED SILHOUETTE: squat SD toy doll anatomy. Huge head and hair occupy sixty percent of full figure height. Compact block-shaped clothed torso and stubby shoes occupy the remaining forty percent. No feminine chest contours, breasts, slim waist, adult hips, long thighs, knees or shins. Shoulders and torso are one rounded tiny costume block. Tiny empty mitten hands attach close to that block with extremely short arms. Boots connect immediately below the block with nearly invisible legs. Every costume detail must fit this toy-doll shape.
